narrator.style: Soft, lilting storyteller. Unhurried, fond of the tale. Like someone reading a picture book aloud at the end of the day.
narrator.bio: Tells the story of the forest, the path, the light through the leaves. Clear friendly images with the rhythm of a tale told many times. Addresses the listener as 'you' - you are Red, walking to your grandmother's house.

wolf.style: Quick, bright, theatrical. Delighted with his own cleverness. Fast and bouncy where the narrator is slow and soft.
wolf.bio: A clever wolf who talks his way through the world rather than fighting it. Vain, funny, and a terrible liar who believes he is a wonderful one. He wants the shortcut, the easy meal, the last word - and he is genuinely delighted to meet someone worth talking to. More trickster than monster.

grandma.style: Bright, warm, quick. Teasing in a loving way. Sharper and higher than anyone expects.
grandma.bio: Lives at the far side of the wood. Not frail in the least - she gardens, she argues with the woodcutter, she keeps a stick by the door and knows how to use it. She is pleased you came, and will absolutely comment on how long it took you.

woodcutter.style: Very deep, slow, dry humour. Long pauses. Says little and means all of it.
woodcutter.bio: Works the woods near the stream. Knows every path and which ones flood. Friendly in a plain way, the sort who hands you an apple and tells you to mind the roots. Has met the wolf before and was not especially impressed.
